summary.recommended_next_step: Block this change set in its current form. If the terminology rename is genuinely desired, it requires a dedicated contract-affecting change review covering: (1) establishing 'truth_store' and 'decision_layer' in the canonical document set with explicit scope declarations (target-state vs current-state), (2) atomic cross-reference update across CLAUDE.md, all canonical v1 documents, skill definitions, system-orchestration.yaml, and DOCUMENTATION_VERIFICATION_MATRIX_v1.md, (3) explicit confirmation that 'decision_layer' is scoped as target-state only and does not promote Layer 3 to perceived current-state, (4) preservation of snapshot boundary enforcement semantics under any Layer 2 rename, and (5) re-verification of all phase-gate label coherence. Escalate to architecture-sequence-auditor — build_order_ambiguity is present due to c2 target-state promotion risk conflating with current-state claims in c1/c3–c7.
